name: spike-gaps
//: The board-copy-gaps feasibility spike, preserved on its branch and never landed. Its tests drive target/debug/onetaskgraph and the prototype, so `test` depends on both builds and on `bootstrap`, which makes the project's own .venv from requirements.txt. `build` builds the reachability-closure prototype the offline tests run; the live probes are never a target, because they spend the test board's shared GitHub allowance and run only from spike/gaps/gaps.sh.

options.command: uv venv -q --allow-existing --python 3.13 .venv && uv pip install -q --python .venv -r requirements.txt

bootstrap.//: Uncached: it reaches PyPI and writes spike/gaps/.venv, outside the cacheable output set.

build.//: Uncached: it builds into a clone under the user's cache directory, outside the cacheable output set.
